provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Concordia Venus rules (PD-Verlag / Rio Grande, V1.1)

steps.text: Choose a board (Hellas or Ionium); Ionium works with 2-3 players without its 3 Italian provinces
steps.ref: Concordia Venus Game Setup sheet (PD-Verlag), On the development

steps.text: Shuffle the 30 city tokens letter side up; deal them to the cities with the matching letter, then flip them (Hellas: box the D tokens)
Each province gets the bonus marker of its most valuable good: cloth 7, wine 6, tools 5, food 4, bricks 3
Take the 30 cards for sale with a column on the back
Take the 30 cards for sale with the double circle on the back
Box cards with a numeral above the player count; shuffle each numeral and stack I on top, then II and so on
Top 7 cards faceup in the display; the stack and the Concordia card beside it
Random start player; Praefectus Magnus to the last player in turn order
Teams of 2 sit opposite each other; the start player takes the orange turn order marker
Each player: scoring marker on 0; 1 land and 1 sea colonist in the capital
Each team's second partner puts their 2 starting colonists in a free city not next to the capital
Storehouse: the other 4 colonists plus 2 food, 1 cloth, 1 wine, 1 brick, 1 tool
15 houses of your colour and a player aid
The 8 column-marked starting cards in hand
The 7 double-circle starting cards; the first partner boxes the Diplomat, the second the Architect (6 cards each)
Starting money by seat: 5, 6, 7... sestertii
Starting money: first team 5 each, second team 6 each, third team 7 each
Team play: your partner also carries out the card you play
steps.ref: Concordia Venus rules (PD-Verlag / Rio Grande, V1.1), Game flow

steps.text: Team play: only sestertii may be shared; your partner must give cash you need
steps.ref: Concordia Venus rules (PD-Verlag / Rio Grande, V1.1), Stockpile and Sestertii

steps.text: First game: score everyone after their first Tribune; best gets 2, second 1 sestertius
steps.ref: Concordia Venus rules (PD-Verlag / Rio Grande, V1.1), Intermediate Scoring

steps.text: Last display card bought or 15th house built: Concordia card (7 VP), then everyone else one more turn
steps.ref: Concordia Venus rules (PD-Verlag / Rio Grande, V1.1), Game End

steps.text: The start player plays 1 card from hand and carries out its action
steps.ref: Concordia Venus Game Setup sheet (PD-Verlag), Game Flow
